messages:
sarah (Account Exec): Need a proofpack for Zephyr Inc.'s SIG/CAIQ review — they asked specifically for SSO/SAML metadata, MFA enforcement evidence, an RBAC/least-privilege mapping, service-account policies, and sample audit logs. Deadline: Friday EOD. Who can own this?
jonathan (Solutions Engineer): I can pull SAML metadata and take screenshots of the Okta mappings. I'll need the customer tenant alias (org-id). @sarah can you confirm?
sarah (Account Exec): Tenant alias is zephyr-pp. Also they want delegated admin role docs and confirmation of SCIM support. ETA expectation — can we do 48–72 hrs?
jonathan (Solutions Engineer): 48 hrs for SAML + RBAC screenshots sounds doable. Audit logs will depend on redaction turnaround. @mike (Security) — can you export redacted auth logs for the last 30 days? CSV preferred.
mike (Security): I can. Will redact IPs/userids. CSV ok. For MFA enforcement proof: we enforce MFA for both console and API via TOTP + optional FIDO2 for SSO. I'll attach the policy excerpt and Okta sign-on policy screenshots.
emma (Sales Engineer): Quick Q — do they want the full role list or a least-privilege mapping matrix? I recommend least-privilege mapping + representative role JSON samples.
jonathan (Solutions Engineer): Agreed. We'll include least-privilege mapping + example terraform/infra snippet for service-account role bindings, e.g. `resource "redwood_role_binding" { role = "analytics_read" principals = ["svc-analytics"] }`.
mike (Security): I'll include an example redacted audit line for illustration: `2026-03-18T14:23:05Z auth_success user=service-account-analytics action=assume_role mfa_used=true` — will sanitize any PII.
sarah (Account Exec): Also confirm SCIM provisioning support for user lifecycle? They'll ask.
jonathan (Solutions Engineer): Yes — SCIM supported. Need a customer API token for provisioning. Adding docs link: https://docs.redwood.ai/integrations/scim (public docs).
emma (Sales Engineer): We should include rotation cadence for service account keys and KMS/HSM integration notes. Suggest putting rotation policy (90 days) and a short paragraph about KMS support.
mike (Security): Will include service-account rotation policy doc and HSM notes. For CAIQ we should attach a short one-pager summarizing our controls and pointing to the full artifacts.
jonathan (Solutions Engineer): I'll assemble a zip called `redwood-iam-proofpack.zip` containing: `saml-metadata.xml`, `okta-policies.pdf`, `rbac-matrix.csv`, `service-accounts.json`, `audit-sample.csv`, `scim-guide.pdf`, and a one-pager summary.
emma (Sales Engineer): Uploading draft now to a shared folder — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyzPlaceholder (will replace with final link). Tag me when done and I'll review the RBAC mappings.
mike (Security): Starting redaction now. ETA for redacted logs: 24 hours. Will add sign-on policy screenshots showing enforced MFA and an event blocked due to missing MFA.
jonathan (Solutions Engineer): Once I have the files I'll upload and ping @sarah. I'll also produce a short readme that explains each artifact and what to show the vendor reviewer.
sarah (Account Exec): Perfect — please ensure RBAC matrix maps each role to minimal privileges and includes a column for 'example user/test account' we gave them during POC. We need to get this to Zephyr by Friday 18:00 PST.
emma (Sales Engineer): Will do. I'll validate the mapping and write a 2-paragraph summary for the SOC reviewer.
mike (Security): Done with initial redaction pass. Uploading audit sample to the draft folder and adding a PDF excerpt of the MFA policy.
deploy-bot: File `redwood-iam-proofpack_v1.zip` uploaded to https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyzPlaceholder (internal).
jonathan (Solutions Engineer): Got the upload. I'll rename files for clarity and add the terraform snippet and sample policy JSON. Then I'll ping @sarah for final review.
sarah (Account Exec): Thanks everyone — big win if we get this packaged cleanly. If any blockers, ping me immediately.
(End of thread)
